description: Baseline geometry planner: 32/50 successes with 25 remote workers.

asi.hypothesis: Current fixed straight-arm geometry is a measurable baseline; failures cluster at grasp and transport.
asi.run_integrity: 45/50 terminal results; 5 seeds missing, so success count is conservative.
asi.next_action: Honor user request: rerun with 10 workers, then redesign geometry rather than tune small thresholds.

description: Benchmark with requested 10 workers: 36/50 successes, all 50 terminal results.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing concurrency makes benchmark complete and improves measured outcomes, but grasp and transport remain dominant planner failures.
asi.next_action: Inspect failure-stage distribution and redesign end-to-end geometry, not threshold/retry micro-fixes.

description: Tried 65-degree shoulder-pan and live TCP-to-base parking; 12/50, worse than 36/50.

asi.hypothesis: Moving shoulder pan far inward and recomputing base offset would improve IK margin.
asi.result: False: grasp success collapsed and transport/placement counts fell; fixed straight-arm 85-degree geometry is important for downstream reach.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 24 successes.
asi.next_action: Revert; use measured pre-grasp arm pose while retaining 85-degree transport geometry. Redesign final grasp orientation/approach instead of global pan change.

description: Added alternate front-facing live-geometry grasp after straight-arm grasp fails: 38/50.

asi.hypothesis: Initial failures were invalid wrist orientation, not just distance; a horizontal front grasp reconstructed from live TCP-to-cup vector should recover them without perturbing successful runs.
asi.result: Improved 36→38; all runs complete. Remaining failures should be analyzed at regrasp, transport, and lift/evaluation stages.
asi.next_action: Use same geometric grasp-frame idea for tray regrasp and replace coarse transport target with payload-centered route.

description: Replaced oscillatory transport with fixed-arm screw L-route and exact y correction: 42/50.

asi.hypothesis: Transport failures came from velocity-map oscillation and coarse 0.15m base stopping; fixed-arm screw waypoints preserve payload transform and exact target geometry.
asi.result: Improved 38→42; stage12 rose to 40 and all 50 runs completed.
asi.next_action: Analyze remaining 8 failures. Focus on tray support/regrasp and lift geometry; retain fixed-arm transport.

description: Used fixed-arm screw geometry for initial base staging and live TCP-offset pre-grasp parking: 45/50.

asi.hypothesis: Initial grasp failures came from base screw replanning the arm and stopping coarse; preserve arm pose during an L-shaped approach and park base from measured TCP offset.
asi.result: Strong improvement 42→45; every seed now reaches grasp and tray transport, remaining failures occur after final release.
asi.next_action: Inspect five final-release failures; redesign support/release/return placement geometry, not initial grasp.

description: Regrasp closes at release pose and validates vertical detachment from tray: 48/50.

asi.hypothesis: Remaining failures were caused by lowering/regrasping into tray support, then mistaking contact for attachment; close at already aligned release pose and lift off immediately.
asi.result: Improved 45→48; only two final failures remain, with all seeds reaching stage 12 release.
asi.next_action: Inspect seeds 35 and 47 final failure geometry; target final counter placement/release dynamics.

description: Skip redundant second lift after verified Stage 8 detachment; complete 50/50.

asi.hypothesis: Direct Stage 8 lift test already raises and verifies cup, but Stage 9 demanded another +5cm from the already-raised reference and falsely aborted.
asi.result: Reached 50/50 with 50 terminal results and no errors affecting outcome; all stages completed.
asi.next_action: Run one independent 50/10 confirmation to check generality and avoid accepting a lucky/stale metric.

description: Independent confirmation with 10 workers: 50/50 successes, all stages complete.

asi.hypothesis: The 50/50 result was not a one-run fluke; geometry remains stable across an independent full seed batch.
asi.result: Confirmed 50/50; no missing runs and no failed result events.
asi.next_action: Stop optimization at requested target. Preserve fixed-arm staging/transport and verified tray detachment geometry; do not add complexity.

description: Final validation retry hit remote gangway connection failure before workers launched.

asi.hypothesis: No planner behavior change intended; validation rerun should confirm 50/50 after harmless exception handling cleanup.
asi.error: remote_analyze failed during remote run-dir creation: Connection closed by UNKNOWN port 65535.
asi.rollback_reason: No benchmark data; infrastructure crash, not planner regression.
asi.next_action: Keep confirmed 50/50 result; do not spend another full run on no-op lint cleanup unless remote connection is stable.

description: Independent verification of d94fd277 TakeItBack planner: 50/50 successes with 10 workers, all stages complete.

asi.hypothesis: Re-run exact restored stable commit with prescribed 50 seeds and 10 workers to verify recorded 50/50.
asi.result: Confirmed 50/50 terminal successes, completed=50, stage3=50, stage5=50, stage12=50, missing=0; 3 non-fatal error events did not affect outcomes.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric unchanged at the already confirmed 50/50 ceiling; validation only.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep HEAD at d94fd277 and do not perturb stable TakeItBack geometry without new failure evidence.

description: 100-seed validation with 25 workers: 97/100 successes, all 100 terminal results.

asi.hypothesis: Validate stable TakeItBack planner beyond prescribed 50-seed confirmation under 25-worker concurrency.
asi.result: 97/100 successes; 100/100 completed; stage3=99, stage5=97, stage12=97; 10 non-fatal error events; failed result directories include seeds 78 and 91.
asi.run_integrity: Complete batch with no missing terminal results; success counts use terminal result events only.
asi.next_action: Inspect seeds 78, 91, and remaining failed terminal event before any planner change; retain 50/10 target and avoid tuning without failure evidence.

description: Validated compact bent-carry and fixed-arm screw geometry: 100/100 successes with 25 workers.

asi.hypothesis: Replace straight-arm Stage 1/5 geometry with previously validated compact bent-carry pose, fixed-arm screw staging, and live pre-grasp correction.
asi.result: 100/100 successes; all terminal results; stage3=100, stage5=100, stage12=100, missing=0; one non-fatal error event did not affect terminal success.
asi.run_integrity: Complete 100-seed batch at 25 workers; no failed result events or missing runs.
asi.next_action: Run same validated planner with 10 workers as requested; compare workload-only behavior and failure distribution.

description: 10-worker validation after geometry fix: 100/100 successes, all stages complete.

asi.hypothesis: Worker count alone should not change validated planner outcome; rerun exact 100-seed batch with 10 workers.
asi.result: 100/100 successes at 10 workers; completed=100, stage3=100, stage5=100, stage12=100, missing=0; one non-fatal error event, no failed terminal results.
asi.next_action: Keep 10-worker configuration; explain 97/100 as prior straight-arm geometry failure, not worker-count loss.

description: Recorded FridgeVeggies baseline: 70/100 successes with 10 workers.

asi.hypothesis: Establish current 100-seed baseline before planner changes.
asi.result: 70/100 successes; all 100 terminal results; 30 failures: 15 reach, 6 invalid lifts, 9 transport-to-plate failures.
asi.run_integrity: Complete 100-seed, 10-worker batch; no missing runs. Batch used no-video support only, no motion-logic change.
asi.next_action: Fix shared reach/transport geometry with general fallbacks; validate every candidate on full 100/10 batch.

description: Transport payload-target experiment: unchanged at 70/100 on 10 workers.

asi.hypothesis: Using live payload-aware base target instead of raw vegetable residual would recover transport failures without changing grasp geometry.
asi.result: Full 100-seed rerun stayed 70/100; completed=100, missing=0. Transport fix did not improve aggregate under this workload.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric unchanged; no evidence this isolated transport patch helps current batch.
asi.next_action: Keep reverted baseline; next iteration requested at 25 workers should first measure concurrency effect, then target reach/grasp failures separately.

description: 25-worker FridgeVeggies baseline: 69/100 successes, all runs completed.

asi.hypothesis: Measure worker-count effect requested by user without planner changes.
asi.result: 69/100 at 25 workers versus 70/100 at 10; completed=100, missing=0. Concurrency changes outcome slightly but does not explain main failure gap.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change; lower primary metric than 10-worker baseline.
asi.next_action: Keep 10-worker baseline as reference; continue geometry work with 25 workers only when requested, starting with reach/grasp strategy rather than transport-only patch.

description: Deterministic 25-worker FridgeVeggies baseline: 70/100 successes.

asi.hypothesis: Enable enhanced deterministic CPU PhysX ordering to remove run-to-run physics drift seen for identical seed 10.
asi.result: 70/100 at 25 workers, completed=100, missing=0; improves prior 25-worker 69/100 but matches 10-worker 70/100.
asi.run_integrity: Complete 100-seed batch; one worker setting and deterministic simulation are only workload/runtime changes.
asi.next_action: Keep determinism and test a general grasp geometry change next; do not treat worker count as cause of 30 failures.

description: Pre-grasp clearance fallback experiment aborted before benchmark completion.

asi.rollback_reason: User interrupted the 100-seed, 25-worker benchmark before metrics were produced; no planner result is valid.
asi.next_action: Search git history for a validated FridgeVeggies 50/50 planner before resuming experiments.

asi.error: run_experiment was aborted by follow-on request before remote workers launched; no benchmark output or logs.

description: Clean one-seed remote baseline after terminating stale planner batches.

asi.hypothesis: Stale remote planner groups, not zombie processes, cause startup/polling delay; a clean one-seed run should complete without inherited GPU contention.
asi.result: Passed in 113.6s; one terminal result, no missing run. GPU was idle after cleanup. Planner itself ran about 55s from event timestamps; setup/poll/sync account for remainder.
asi.run_integrity: Single seed completed; result was planner failure, but latency path completed normally.
asi.next_action: Time sync, run-dir seeding, launch, polling, and log pull separately; inspect remote runner process matching before a larger batch.

description: FridgeVeggies baseline at 25 workers after clean remote run: 36/50 successes.

asi.hypothesis: Current planner with pre-clear fallback provides baseline for geometry-first staging fixes at fixed 50 seeds and 25 workers.
asi.result: 36/50 terminal successes, 50/50 completed, missing=0, errors=937. Server run integrity clean; this is planner failure, not missing data.
asi.next_action: Apply one coherent base-staging correction: remeasure actual base-to-target geometry after yaw and close to a collision-free reachable stance before arm reach.

description: Clamped diagonal base stances south of counter front and tightened post-yaw reach gate: 23/50, worse than 36/50.

asi.hypothesis: Diagonal stance targets crossed counter-front geometry, causing downstream cabinet collisions; safe-y clamp plus stricter measured base-to-vegetable gate should recover stance failures.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed, but successes fell 36→23. Safe y clamp removed useful diagonal reach geometry or left the arm/base at a worse workspace; hypothesis not sufficient and candidate is reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 13 successes; no missing-run explanation.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not globally clamp diagonal targets. Preserve baseline and test a collision-aware stance candidate that keeps approach geometry while measuring actual post-drive base pose; inspect failed seeds from this candidate before another change.

description: Lowered post-yaw corrective-drive threshold 0.68→0.60 without changing stance targets: 35/50, unchanged within noise and below baseline.

asi.hypothesis: Yaw drift leaves actual base-to-vegetable distance outside the high pre-grasp envelope; earlier corrective drive should improve reach margin.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed with 35/50, versus baseline 36/50. Isolated threshold change does not improve aggregate and adds no reliable evidence.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric decreased by 1; candidate is not an improvement.
asi.next_action_hint: Restore baseline threshold. Next test should alter the pre-grasp geometry/arm clearance from a valid stance, not only the distance cutoff.

description: Changed diagonal approach directions from ±40° to a more southern ±30° while preserving distances and grasp logic: 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: Original diagonal stances approach too far north toward cabinet; a more southern lateral corridor should reduce arm/door collision while retaining lateral reach alternatives.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed, 39/50 successes versus baseline 36/50; +3 improvement, no missing runs. Direction change is promising but not sufficient for 100%.
asi.next_action: Keep ±30° diagonals. Analyze remaining five failed seeds; next isolate first failed stage and improve pre-grasp clearance/stance feasibility without broad threshold hacks.

description: Tried low pre-clear 0.10 before 0.14 with ±30° diagonals: 27/50, worse than 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: Shorter pre-grasp clearance preserves horizontal reach and avoids final counter collision from high pre-grasp.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed, but SR fell 39→27; low pre-clear first causes more reach/contact failures. Preserve high 0.14 first; candidate reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 12 successes.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep ±30° and 0.14-first. Next target is post-yaw/base re-stance or a safer final vertical grasp geometry; do not reorder pre-clear globally.

description: Reordered final grasp heights to try 0.02 before 0.0 with ±30° stance: 27/50, worse than 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: A small positive grasp-height offset could clear counter during first fingertip contact and prevent side-pushing flat vegetables.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed, but SR fell 39→27 and error volume rose; changing raise order globally is harmful. Candidate reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 12 successes.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep raise_z=0.0 first. Next change should stabilize the base/arm state before grasp attempts or use a verified collision-free candidate selection, not global grasp-height reorder.

description: Tried diagonal distance order 0.6→0.5 before 0.5→0.6: 39/50, unchanged.

asi.hypothesis: The shorter ±30° diagonal stance enters the cabinet-front region; try safer 0.6m diagonal first to avoid initial collision/knock.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 39/50, identical to current best; no measurable gain. Candidate reverted under unchanged-primary rule.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric unchanged at 39.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep baseline ±30° order. Next isolate arm/counter contact or post-failure recovery; repeated base-distance ordering is not enough.

description: Stale-target remeasure candidate could not run: remote rsync failed before workers launched.

asi.hypothesis: Re-reading target pose before every raise_z may prevent stale-target knock cascades.
asi.error: remote_analyze failed during rsync to gangway after 141.1s; no benchmark workers or terminal logs produced.
asi.rollback_reason: Infrastructure crash, no planner metric; candidate not judged.
asi.next_action_hint: Verify gangway/NFS/remote cache health and clean any partial run dir before retrying; do not alter planner based on this run.

description: Retried per-raise target remeasurement after transient rsync crash: 37/50, below ±30° baseline 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: Failed approximate reach can move vegetables; re-reading object pose before every raise_z should prevent stale-target retries and knock cascades.
asi.result: Infrastructure-clean retry completed 50/25 with 37/50, not 39/50. Global remeasurement introduces harmful target drift/recovery behavior; candidate reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric 2 below current best; first attempt had no metric due rsync crash, second was valid.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep single object measurement after a successful corrective reach. Focus next on maintaining a safe folded arm/base stance between failed grasp candidates or improving lift verification.

description: Zeroed robot qvel after arm folding before stance attempts: 35/50, worse than ±30° baseline 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: Stale residual qvel after set_qpos folding lets arm/base drift back into furniture during fallback stance recovery.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed, but successes fell 39→35; resetting all qvel perturbs useful solver/controller state or removes momentum needed for base staging. Candidate reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 4 successes.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not reset all qvel globally. Keep ±30° geometry; address final descend counter collision and base recovery with pose/clearance logic rather than velocity reset.

description: Projected ±30° base approach targets south of dynamic counter front while keeping baseline gates: 38/50, below 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: Unsafe diagonal target y caused base/cabinet contact; dynamic safe-front projection should preserve lateral geometry while preventing entry into fixture.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 38/50; lower than current ±30° baseline 39. The target projection changes useful approach geometry despite plausible clearance benefit.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 1 from best.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep unprojected ±30° geometry. Global next step should change arm/base planning sequence, not target clipping; preserve current 39/50 commit.

description: Restored all vegetable collisions before final descend and excluded only target: 36/50, below current ±30° best 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: Excluding all vegetables during final descend lets fingers plan through distractors and causes physical pushes; target-only exclusion should preserve collision corridor.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 36/50. The broader collision allowance appears necessary for current fingertip-grasp geometry; this isolated ACM change is harmful and reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 3 from current best.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not change ACM alone. A global corridor redesign must coordinate high pre-grasp, final descend, and contact geometry together.

description: Added collision-aware 3 cm staging descend, then target-only final close: 34/50, worse than 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: Keeping target/distractors solid during the long vertical descend would prevent planned-through-object pushes, while target-only ACM exclusion handles final wrap.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 34/50; the target-included staging pose is too collision-constrained or changes grasp contact geometry. Candidate reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 5 successes.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep existing all-vegetable exclusion for final fingertip descend. Pursue global live-frame base/arm corridor rather than splitting the final descend.

description: Added collision-aware joint base-x/y plus arm fallback after fixed-base reach failure: 38/50, below 39/50.

asi.hypothesis: A joint plan could repair bad base stance while keeping yaw fixed and avoid repeated fixed-base IK failures.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 38/50. Mobile fallback did not improve and likely perturbed recovery state; current fixed-base route remains better.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 1 from current best.
asi.next_action_hint: Revert fallback. Next global change should reduce repeated stance retries and use one deterministic collision-free reach/carry geometry, not add a second planner path.

description: Exact ±30° current-best control rerun: 38/50; prior 39/50 is within workload variance.

asi.hypothesis: Confirm 39/50 before global redesign; repeat current code under same 50/25 workload.
asi.result: Control completed 38/50, all terminal events; prior 39 is not stable by one run. Use 38-39 as baseline band, not overfit to one seed batch.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change and no improvement over measured current-best control.
asi.next_action_hint: Prefer global geometric redesign, validate candidates against full runs, and require robust improvement beyond 38-39 rather than one-seed gain.

description: Added south staging corridor before each target approach, safe counter-front projection, and retained ±30° diagonals: 40/50.

asi.hypothesis: Route folded arm/base through a south free-space corridor before final stance; direct fallback drives were entering cabinet/counter and poisoning later grasp attempts.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 40/50, +2 over exact ±30° control 38/50; missing=0. Global route is promising and improves stance robustness, but 10 failures remain.
asi.next_action: Keep staging corridor. Analyze remaining failed seeds and address shared final grasp/lift/transport geometry without reverting safe route.

description: Added south staging corridor plus safe-front projection before each approach: 37/50, below current staged baseline 40/50.

asi.hypothesis: A two-stage open-space route would prevent base wedging during direct approach and reduce downstream cabinet collisions.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 37/50. Extra staging plus projection over-constrains base geometry and harms useful paths; candidate reverted.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 3 from current best staged baseline.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep only proven ±30° diagonal geometry. Stop adding base waypoints; target the shared grasp/lift configuration with a measured vertical approach.

description: Anchored base XY during yaw with closed-loop translational compensation: 34/50, worse than staged baseline 40/50.

asi.hypothesis: Yaw-only commands let base slide 0.15–0.26m; XY hold should preserve measured stance and prevent arm/cabinet failures.
asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 34/50. Translation compensation changes base dynamics adversely near the fixture; current unanchored yaw path performs better.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric dropped 6 successes.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep baseline yaw implementation. Avoid micro-control changes; next global attempt should redesign fixed arm/grasp corridor or transport geometry.
